video_goal: Demonstrate the visual steps to securely install a Diono Radian 3R car seat using SuperLATCH in a tight 3-across vehicle back seat configuration.
required_subjects_and_props: Diono Radian 3R car seat, SuperLATCH connectors, vehicle back seat with lower anchors and top tether, two additional pre-installed car seats.

outline_steps.visual_action: Camera pans across a vehicle back seat showing two installed car seats with a narrow empty space in the middle.
Hands unfold the bottom base of the Diono Radian 3R car seat until it clicks into its rigid L-shape.
Hands lower the narrow Diono Radian 3R car seat directly into the tight middle space between the two existing car seats.
Fingers unclip the SuperLATCH connectors with red release buttons from the storage slots on the back of the Diono seat.
Hands thread the SuperLATCH strap through the side opening of the forward-facing belt path on the car seat.
A hand pushes the metal SuperLATCH connector directly onto the vehicle's lower anchor bar deep in the seat bight.
The opposite hand pushes the second SuperLATCH connector onto the other lower anchor bar in the seat bight.
A hand pushes down heavily on the Diono seat pan while the other hand pulls the SuperLATCH tightening strap straight up.
Hands grip the side of the Diono seat at the belt path and push it left and right, showing minimal movement.
Hands toss the top tether strap with a metal hook over the top of the vehicle seat headrest.
Fingers snap the top tether hook onto the metal anchor bracket located on the back of the vehicle seat.
A hand pulls the loose tail of the top tether strap downwards until the strap becomes completely taut.
Camera slowly zooms out to show the Diono Radian 3R sitting flush and secure in a complete 3-across car seat setup.
